title: The deployed mail transport sends nothing to reserved test domains, and the whitelist mail carries no joomlart.com link, no reader address and goes out once per address per day
steps: S1: From the TCH checkout run: node --test --test-reporter=tap apps/tracy-web/test/beta-waitlist-mail.test.mjs apps/tracy-web/test/mail-unavailable.test.mjs apps/tracy-web/test/web-languages.test.mjs

S2: Record the exit code, the '# tests', '# pass', '# fail' lines and the result of each case whose name starts with: "spam audit 05/10/2026: the deployed Resend transport sends nothing to a reserved test domain"; "the whitelist letter links to the bare whitelist page"; "one whitelist letter per address per day"; "the \"could not check yet\" letter is counted apart"; "betaMail: the whitelist mail in Spanish keeps the link".
expect: Every named case is 'ok': the transport from transportFor makes no Resend call for example.test, example.org, sub.example.com, .invalid, .localhost or EXAMPLE.NET and logs no address, while notexample.com, example.com.vn, gmail.com and tracy.ai are sent; the whitelist mail's link is the bare whitelist URL with no reader address; three refusals for one address in one day mail once, another address and the next day mail again; joomlart.com is never an href and never a raw autolinkable string in the HTML.
evidence: Resend API 05/10/2026: 326 of 695 mails in 30 days bounced, 310 on 04/10, all to e2e-*@example.test from DEV through the key production shares; Gmail filed 'Join the Tracy whitelist' in Spam while the sign-in code reached the Inbox.
fence: The deployed transport refuses reserved recipient domains before any provider call; the beta queue's per-address daily bucket.

tests: spam audit 05/10/2026: the deployed Resend transport sends nothing to a reserved test domain
the whitelist letter links to the bare whitelist page
one whitelist letter per address per day
the "could not check yet" letter is counted apart
betaMail: the whitelist mail in Spanish keeps the link
